description: This file defines a custom memory zone for Darwin (OS X) using jemalloc, including struct definitions, function implementations for memory management, and registration logic for the zone.

methods.name: zone_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocated block, checking ownership.

methods.name: zone_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory using je_malloc.

methods.name: zone_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory using je_calloc.

methods.name: zone_valloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with page alignment using je_posix_memalign.

methods.name: zone_free
methods.description: Frees memory, using je_free if owned by jemalloc.

methods.name: zone_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory using je_realloc if owned by jemalloc.

methods.name: zone_memalign
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory using je_posix_memalign.

methods.name: zone_free_definite_size
methods.description: Frees memory with known size, asserting size matches.

methods.name: zone_destroy
methods.description: Placeholder that should never be called.

methods.name: zone_batch_malloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple blocks at once.

methods.name: zone_batch_free
methods.description: Frees multiple blocks.

methods.name: zone_pressure_relief
methods.description: Stub returning 0, for pressure relief.

methods.name: zone_good_size
methods.description: Returns a size suitable for allocation, using sz_s2u.

methods.name: zone_enumerator
methods.description: Enumerator for zone memory ranges, stub returning success.

methods.name: zone_check
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating zone is okay.

methods.name: zone_print
methods.description: Stub for printing zone info.

methods.name: zone_log
methods.description: Stub for logging zone activity.

methods.name: zone_force_lock
methods.description: Locks the zone, handling threading and forking.

methods.name: zone_force_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the zone, handling threading and forking.

methods.name: zone_statistics
methods.description: Fills in statistics, but currently stubbed.

methods.name: zone_locked
methods.description: Indicates if zone is locked, always false.

methods.name: zone_reinit_lock
methods.description: Reinitializes lock, calls zone_force_unlock.

methods.name: zone_init
methods.description: Initializes the jemalloc zone with function pointers.

methods.name: zone_default_get
methods.description: Retrieves the default zone, handling special OSX cases.

methods.name: zone_promote
methods.description: Unregisters and re-registers zones to promote jemalloc zone to default.

methods.name: zone_register
methods.description: Registers the custom jemalloc zone and promotes it to default.
